title: Trinity Square Apartments, Townsend Street, Dublin 2, Dublin 2
seoTitle: Trinity Square Apartments, Townsend Street, Dublin 2, Dublin 2
description:
Bright and private 1 bed apt, with plenty of personality, available immediately.  
The apartment is on the top floor so is very private, sharing the floor with only 2 other apartments.
The accommodation comprises of entrance hall with Bathroom, hot press/storage press, bedroom next then the sitting cum dining & kitchen.  There are wooden floors throughout apart from the bathroom that has enviroclad hard wearing easy clean material on the floor and walls.  The bathroom has a rain shower, bath, wc and wash hand basin with plenty of shelving. The bedroom has a double bed, bedside lockers and a built in wardrobe, blackout cellular blind and blackout thermal curtains.
The main room is spacious and bright due to the full length balcony doors and windows.  There is a bistro set on the balcony for outdoor eating or just enjoying the views of the IFSC and the river Liffey. There is a three seater sofabed in the sitting room and dining table and 6 chairs.   There is a Samsung TV and a fireplace with an electric fire with remote.  Storage heaters throughout. The kitchen has a large fridge freezer, dishwasher, oven, microwave and plenty of storage. There is also has a small attic for additional storage.

A 6 month lease initially and if both parties are happy an additional 6 year lease with the option to extend if desired.

The apt is ideally located as is
1 min walk to Pearse St DART station, Trinity College & the IFSC
5 min walk to airport bus stop
7 mins walk to LUAS tram and Facebook
10 mins walk to Google Grafton St, Tara St, Temple Bar, Holles St, Merrion Sq., Grand Canal Dock, O'Connell St. and Dame St. etc..
There is a fleet of Dublin City Bikes right outside the main gate of the Apt complex which are free to use.
There is off street parking free from 7pm-7am.
Carpark spaces available to rent from the management company.
